title: Switchboard already calls its main window "the board"

options.label: Review (Needs you inside it)
options.act: Feature named Review; CLI `switchboard review …`; folder `.review/`
options.then: Call it Review everywhere: the menu, the window, `switchboard review`, and `.review/`.

options.label: Keep "board" and rename Switchboard's main window

why: In Switchboard's code the main window is the board ("The board is clear. Every project is open in its own window." in ContentView.swift). Calling this the board as well would make two different boards. Call it Review, as Flex does ("Flex Review"): the menu item is Review, the window is Review, the inbox inside it is Needs you, the agent runs switchboard review add, and the cards live in .review/. I've used those names from here on.
